[[Grand Canyon Brotherhood of Steel|Grand Canyon Brotherhood]] |rank =Elder |location =[[Grand Canyon]] |titles = |family = |TV actor =[[Chris Browning]] }} The '''Grand Canyon elder''' is a leader of the [[Grand Canyon Brotherhood of Steel|Grand Canyon Brotherhood]], a chapter of the [[Brotherhood of Steel]]. ==Background== The elder of a separate Brotherhood of Steel chapter based in the [[Grand Canyon]] region in 2296. This is one of the Brotherhood's regional branches, subordinate to the larger organizational structure but enjoying considerable autonomy. The elder is an elderly man (approximately 60+ years old), with a stern, experienced, and slightly cynical appearance. He has a well-groomed, gray-white beard of medium length and gray receding hair combed back. He has blue eyes and wrinkles on his forehead and around his eyes. The elder also has a scar with an inset Arizona [[license plate]] with the embossed inscription "GRAND CANYON STATE" acting as a skull plate visible on his forehead. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Golden Rule]]=== The elder was invited by Senior Cleric [[Quintus]] to a secret meeting with strategists from [[Yosemite elder|Yosemite]] and [[Coronado elder|Coronado]]. The purpose was to discuss an alliance and a possible rebellion against the dominant Brotherhood of Steel faction in the Commonwealth on the east coast. During the exchange, the Coronado elder hurled an insult, claiming that one of the squires had been caught having sex with a robot. To this, the Grand Canyon elder calmly replied that such an act was perfectly legal. The Elder is initially neutral, but quickly changes his stance and agrees to Quintus's proposal after demonstrating the ability to mass-produce nuclear cores, making the alliance advantageous for the war against the Commonwealth. ==Appearances== The Grand Canyon elder appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|10=202|12=204}} {{stub|FOTV}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Brotherhood of Steel characters]] [[ru:Старейшина Братства Стали Большого каньона]]
